limitations: Only fixtures already present in the source project are exported; no production database was supplied.
Source archives preserve all markup, scripts, stylesheet data, supplied images and formulas byte-for-byte. They are not normalized business rows.
Dynamic browser snapshots reflect initial page load only. Later interaction-only datasets remain in source expressions/archives.
Employee references preserve each source occurrence independently; contradictory fixtures are not merged.
Runtime snapshots use snapshotDate in Asia/Kuala_Lumpur. Static generated dates use snapshotDate and the host timezone.
